context.title: Context capacity
context.description: Maximum input positions in a forward pass.

layers.title: Blocks
layers.description: Executed decoder blocks; each owns its weights and KV state.

checkpoint_sha256.title: Checkpoint identity
checkpoint_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact artifact bytes or canonical checkpoint.

tokenizer_sha256.title: Tokenizer identity
tokenizer_sha256.description: SHA-256 identity of the exact artifact bytes or canonical checkpoint.

max_new_tokens.title: Maximum new tokens
max_new_tokens.description: Maximum number of selected IDs, including an end token. May stop earlier.

stopping.title: Stopping rule
stopping.description: Stop at the configured model end token or output budget; context capacity also bounds execution.

text.title: Request input
text.description: User text; normalization is declared by the selected tokenizer.
text.default: ann has the cup. ben has the book. who has the cup?

published_tokens.title: Published IDs
published_tokens.description: Every selected ID except TURN_END, including diagnostic control/byte/hex tokens.

unused_budget.title: Unused allowance
unused_budget.description: Requested ceiling minus actual selected ID count.

complete.title: Turn complete
complete.description: True only if TURN_END was selected.

primary.description: Primary subject; must name an admitted ontology concept.

related.description: Other associated concepts; excludes the primary subject.

record_json.title: Exported evidence
record_json.description: Exact exported JSON bytes; preserve numeric lexemes for replay.

run_id.title: Observed run
run_id.description: Current accepted computation identity; null before the first step or after reset.

position.title: Sequence position
position.description: Single selected position in the accepted sequence; determines the exact prefix for Next Token. The recorded computation is derived from this position.

observation_id.title: Executed observation
observation_id.description: Exact observation ID within the selected pass, or null for request and output inspection.

surface.title: Inspection surface
surface.description: Single detail and diagram focus; model requires an observation in the selected computation.

architecture_step.description: Index in the selected architecture walkthrough; never an observation ID.

computation_index.description: Selected computation in a resource execution; null for ordinary token generation.

output_bytes.description: Cumulative application-output bytes consumed; excludes protocol framing. A declared action, not proof that bytes were available.

base_url.description: Relative URL or HTTP(S) object-storage prefix; identical fetch protocol locally and remotely.

decoding_note.description: Malformed output or incomplete terminal encoding. Valid pending byte or UTF-8 prefixes while generation can continue have no diagnostic.

stages.label: Token IDs
stages.detail: Text is encoded into vocabulary IDs.

stages.label: Embedding
stages.detail: Look up token vectors. Learned absolute positions, when configured, are added here.

stages.label: Normalize
stages.detail: Normalize channels using the declared model normalization.

stages.label: Attention
stages.detail: Project Q/K/V, apply positional rotation when configured, mix causal values, and project the result.
Add the attention branch to its input.

stages.label: Normalize
stages.detail: Normalize channels using the declared model normalization.

stages.label: Feed-forward
stages.detail: Project, apply the declared activation, and project back.
Add the feed-forward branch to its input.

stages.label: Vocabulary projection
stages.detail: Project hidden vectors into one logit per vocabulary ID.

inputs.description: Earlier stage indices in this single-block schematic; residual branches remain explicit.

ExecutionSpec.description: Exactly one model and one KV reuse assignment. The implemented resource simulation additionally requires cache, scheduling, transfer and compute-service controls together; partial and duplicate assignments fail before execution.

matmul_flops.description: Executed dense and attention matrix multiply/add operations, counted as two FLOPs per multiply-add. Excludes normalization, activation and softmax.

decoding_notes.description: Request-indexed malformed or incomplete decoding diagnostics; output text remains unmodified.

InferenceMap.description: One containment hierarchy shared by configuration and explanation. Node presence declares a logical responsibility, not executable support. Relationships cross boundaries without creating second parents.
